logic.description: Implemented as a monster natural permanent — never cast (creature innate, in_player_deck false). Natural: an enemy that plans an action in contact with a holder is stone for the rest of that turn (entity.petrifiedTurn; every remaining action is a bare Empty Posture like a lock — a Rule 24 destroy emission still rides), and again every turn it is found in contact while the copies stand. Monster natural permanent (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_natural_permanents): a monster whose creature card has this innate effect starts with 2 copies already cast — one permanent id in permanents_csv plus a copy count in perm_copies_json, power 6 each (perm_power_json), both cards in its permanents holding (they count toward DECK_MIN), none in its deck, never cast (not in its deck, and destroyed copies are archived, so npcCastChoice never sees it). Rule 24 (a die of 6 of the stat of the effect's elements) destroys ONE copy per success (dropPermanent decrements, the destroyed copy's card goes to the monster's ARCHIVE — out of circulation); the effect lasts until both are gone. Wild monsters only (no companion / summon / human or npc_b hero); a restart / rejoin boots with exactly 2 again.

prerequisites.description: Held only by a wild monster whose creature card has this innate effect (no companion / summon / hero).
